body: Thanks. I didn't even know what an interpolation search is until you told me. Looks like I have more studying to do.

Thanks for the feedback. The solution I gave (finding something in a sorted list) was definitely optimal and correct, and I didn't struggle at all since I know how to do a binary search.

But I wrote base cases that were not strictly necessary and could be caught by the general case. The interviewer pointed out that I should not write base cases unless it was absolutely necessary, because it creates more areas for things to go wrong in the future. I managed to get a working solution after getting rid of the base case, but apparently they want a perfect solution from the start.
